scope: Documentary evidence for annotation design. Zero collected completed-transaction SMS. Paraphrases and assistant inferences are not message examples or ground-truth labels.

records.observedFact: The documented mobile flow issues an OTP after a successful request screen; customers subsequently enter phone, OTP and amount at the ATM before taking cash.
records.implication: Inference: request success, an amount and an OTP do not by themselves prove that cash was dispensed.

records.observedFact: The wallet FAQ lists cash withdrawal through agents, ATMs and selected Total stations; it also distinguishes an in-app transfer confirmation before completion.
records.implication: Inference: an Orange-branded channel or a fuel-station location alone cannot establish Telecom or Transportation, and pre-completion confirmation is not a completed debit.

records.observedFact: Official university announcement describes semester tuition and installment payment arrangements.
records.implication: User taxonomy applies Education to tuition installments. This publication supports service context, not a real payment record or a universal Installments classification.

records.observedFact: Official announcement offers tuition payment through cards and eFAWATEERcom.
records.implication: Inference: a billing channel is separate from expense purpose. This source does not supply a completed SMS, amount or settlement outcome.

records.observedFact: Official Jordan driver material describes drivers receiving earnings for trips.
records.implication: Inference: the provider name alone does not determine expense direction; driver income is distinct from passenger ride fares.
